offering_description.value: Nuvera sells broadband internet, phone and television services to households and businesses. It builds and operates local telecommunications networks, including fiber connections to homes and businesses.

primary_services.value: fiber and other broadband internet access; local and long-distance phone service; television service; business voice systems

customer_segment.value: B2C: households in communities served by its networks; B2B: local businesses and telecommunications carriers

end_markets.value: residential connectivity and home entertainment; business communications; wholesale telecommunications

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring charges for broadband, phone and television plans; service fees: installation and activation of customer connections; transaction or usage fees: carrier access and usage-based calling charges
revenue_model.category: subscription; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: operates local fiber and telephone networks that connect households, businesses and other carriers; service provider: uses its networks and programming agreements to deliver internet, voice and television to subscribers

specialization.value: related lines: broadband, telephone, television and business voice services delivered over local networks

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: phone-based customer sales and business account representatives; online: company website for checking availability and requesting service; own locations: local customer service offices

regulatory_exposure.value: high: local telephone service and carrier access subject to FCC and state utility commission oversight
